title: Code for: The neural mechanisms of fast versus slow decision-making
description:
Analysis code, figure notebooks and the figures they produce for Nashaat, M., Oraby, H., et al. (2026). The neural mechanisms of fast versus slow decision-making. Neuron, advance online publication. doi:10.1016/j.neuron.2026.10.024.

The code is under the MIT licence; the data/ and results/ folders are under CC BY 4.0. The complete data, including the large two-photon files, are archived separately at doi:10.5281/zenodo.24260552; code/data_downloader.ipynb fetches them.
